title: Pull requests and code review
description: Practice pull requests and code review using a fresh temporary local Git repository, deliberately failing starter and real command assertions without hosted services.
objectives: Explain the Git history/index rule involved in pull requests and code review
Reproduce the starter's incorrect repository state in a disposable local repository
Apply the instructor fix and verify actual Git refs, file contents or status

sources.label: Official Git or GitHub collaboration guide

rubric: I reproduce an actual local git pull requests and code review failure.
I explain the relevant branch, index, history and file state.
I verify fixed refs, commits or ignored paths and name the remaining hosted review gate.
